title: Sparse Reward Subsystem in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.00986v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent studies show that LLM hidden states encode reward-related information, such as answer correctness and model confidence. However, existing approaches typically fit black-box probes on the full hidden states, offering little insight into how this information is structured across neurons. In this paper, we show that reward-related information is concentrated in a sparse subset of neurons. Using simple probing, we identify two types of neurons: value neurons, whose activations predict state value, and dopamine neurons, whose activations encode step-level temporal difference (TD) errors. Together, these neurons form a sparse reward subsystem within LLM hidden states. These names are drawn by analogy with neuroscience, where value neurons and dopamine neurons in the biological reward subsystem also encode value and reward prediction errors, respectively. translated_title: 大语言模型中的稀疏奖励子系统
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，大语言模型的隐藏状态编码了与奖励相关的信息，例如答案正确性和模型置信度。然而，现有方法通常在整个隐藏状态上拟合黑盒探针，对于这些信息在各神经元之间如何组织结构提供的洞察甚少。在本文中，我们证明奖励相关信息集中在稀疏的神经元子集中。通过简单的探测方法，我们识别出两类神经元：价值神经元，其激活可预测状态价值；以及多巴胺神经元，其激活编码步级时序差分（TD）误差。这些神经元共同构成了大语言模型隐藏状态内的一个稀疏奖励子系统。这些命名借鉴了神经科学的类比：生物奖励子系统中的价值神经元和多巴胺神经元也分别编码价值和奖励预测误差。我们证明价值神经元具有鲁棒性，并可在多种数据之间迁移。
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型隐藏状态中存在稀疏的奖励子系统，由预测状态价值的“价值神经元”和编码时序差分误差的“多巴胺神经元”两类神经元组成。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a sparse reward subsystem within LLM hidden states, consisting of value neurons that predict state value and dopamine neurons that encode temporal difference (TD) errors.
